strings.name: Larry Fink
strings.summary: Larry Fink and seven partners founded BlackRock, building fixed-income investing, risk analytics and technology into an international asset-management business. Acquisitions expanded its index and active investment products, while Aladdin became an institutional risk platform. His annual letters address governance and retirement saving; assets managed for clients are not his personal wealth.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026, including his 2026 annual letter. Corporate teamwork is distinguished from individual responsibilities. Client assets are not personal wealth, and investment views are not site recommendations.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded BlackRock and helped develop asset management, index investing and institutional risk-management tools.
